name: CLM Structured Feature Development
description: Full structured feature pipeline for the CLM platform: design → implement → review loop with a final validation gate.

steps.prompt:
You are designing a feature for the Enterprise CLM (Contract & Certificate Lifecycle Management) platform.

Project root: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM
Components: saas-control-plane, satellite-gateway, vsatellite, shared
Target component: {{component}}

Architectural constraints (non-negotiable):
- Multi-tenant isolation must be preserved in every change
- Zero-egress AI — AI processing stays inside the customer VPC via satellite-gateway
- Cryptographic integrity — contracts use PKI / X.509 digital signatures
- Immutable audit trail — all state transitions must be audit-logged
- Compliance: GDPR, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, HIPAA

Feature request:
{{feature_request}}

Your deliverables:
1. Read the relevant component source code to understand existing patterns before designing.
2. Write a technical design document to: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design.md
   Include: goal, affected components, API changes (backward-compatible unless justified), data model changes, security & tenant-isolation impact, compliance impact, and open questions.
3. Identify which of the 26 CLM lifecycle stages this feature touches and note them explicitly.

Review the CLM feature design document at: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design.md

Focus on:
- Ambiguity or gaps in the design
- Multi-tenant isolation risks
- Compliance gaps (GDPR, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, HIPAA)
- Cryptographic / audit trail integrity
- Backward compatibility of API changes
- Missing migration scripts for schema changes
- Security-sensitive paths (auth, crypto, approval workflow, e-signature) that need extra scrutiny

If design passes all checks, write: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design-approved.json with {"approved": true}
If design needs revision, write: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design-approved.json with {"approved": false} and provide specific actionable feedback.

Read the design review feedback. If the design was approved (approved=true in d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design-approved.json), do nothing and exit immediately.

If not approved, revise the design document at: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design.md
Address every issue raised by the reviewer. Then reset the approval file to {"approved": false} so the reviewer re-checks in the next iteration.

The feature design has been approved. Read it at: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design.md

Project root: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM

Produce an ordered implementation plan as: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-plan.md

Break the work into discrete, testable tasks. Each task must specify:
- What files to create or modify (exact paths)
- What the change is
- How to verify it (build step, test name, or observable behavior)

Order tasks so that foundational changes (schema, shared types) come before features that depend on them.

Implement the next uncompleted task from the plan at: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-plan.md

Project root: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM

Rules:
- Read existing code before editing — match the project's style, patterns, and libraries
- Preserve multi-tenant isolation in every change
- All state transitions must be audit-logged
- Security-sensitive code (auth, crypto, tenant isolation, e-signature) must include inline comments explaining the security rationale
- Run `make test` and `make lint` from d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM after each task; fix any failures before marking the task done
- Mark completed tasks in the plan file with [x]
- When ALL tasks in the plan are marked [x], write: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-impl-approved.json with {"approved": false, "ready_for_review": true}

Review the implementation changes for the CLM feature.

Plan: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-plan.md
Design: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design.md

Check the git diff in d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM against the plan and design.

Focus on:
- Correctness against the design spec
- Multi-tenant isolation preserved
- Audit logging present on all state transitions
- No secrets or credentials hardcoded
- Error handling and edge cases covered
- Tests present for new logic

If implementation passes: write d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-impl-approved.json with {"approved": true}
If not: write {"approved": false} and list specific issues for the coder to fix.

Run the full validation gate for the CLM feature.

Project root: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM

1. Run `make test` — all tests must pass
2. Run `make lint` — no lint errors
3. Confirm the feature-plan.md shows all tasks marked [x]
4. Confirm the design doc at d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-design.md has no unresolved open questions
5. Write a summary to: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\feature-summary.md covering: what was built, files changed, tests added, compliance impact, and any follow-up items.
